posts.author: jonathino001
posts.body:
I apologize in advance if this is a dumb question that gets asked all the time, but I've been all over the internet and can't find a clear answer. And I'm totally new to rpgmaker in general so I may be trying to do too much too soon, but here goes:
I want to make it so that when I resize the window the display does not scale up, but just expands the view so that you can see further. And I want to add an option in the menu to scale up the display by fixed integer multipliers (ie 1x, 2x, 3x, ext) so that you retain the clean pixel look without creating black bars on the edge of the screen.
By default the pixels blur, but I've tried a few plugins:
Fixed Scale Fullscreen by Arthran + itaire. Advertises itself as rendering "only exact multiples of the set resolution", but in reality disables the ability to change window size or go fullscreen entirely.
TDDP Pixel Perfect by Galemereth / TDD. Has a setting to enable/disable stretch scaling. When disabled creates black bars when resizing the window. When enabled causes some rows/columns of pixels to be doubled, which looks awful.
Tile Based Scaling by SirLegna. This one actually expands the view like I want, but only along one axis at a time depending on what you've set it to. it'll do the blurry default scaling anyway.
And if I try to use those last two together it bugs out completely and gives me the worst of both worlds.
I feel like this really shouldn't be so difficult. I'm literally trying to get the game to display in a simpler way. I cannot be the only person who wants to make a pixel game that looks like a pixel game in this pixel game making engine. This should be a default feature.

posts.author: Archeia
posts.body:
RPG Maker MV/MZ isn't advertised as a pixel game maker engine. It does support it but you have to do more work and it's not as easy as you think. It's technically:
Code:
window.moveBy(-xDelta / 2, -yDelta / 2);
window.resizeBy(xDelta, yDelta);
But making it work properly like windows not showing scroll bars, etc. is painful.
You can try this one.
Just remember that
If your monitor resolution is 1280×720 and your game uses the default 816×624 resolution, a ×2 scale would require a window size of 1648×1287. Since this exceeds your screen size, the plugin will limit the scale to ×1.
You might also want to add this to your package.json on release build
Code:
"chromium-args": "--force-color-profile=srgb --force-device-scale-factor=1",
If you want it to also work on test play you will want a watcher.

posts.author: jonathino001
posts.body:
Archeia said:
RPG Maker MV/MZ isn't advertised as a pixel game maker engine. It does support it but you have to do more work and it's not as easy as you think. It's technically:
Code:
window.moveBy(-xDelta / 2, -yDelta / 2);
window.resizeBy(xDelta, yDelta);
But making it work properly like windows not showing scroll bars, etc. is painful.
You can try this one.
But if your game's base resolution is, say, 816×624 (RPG Maker MZ default):
×2 would need: 816×2 + 16 = 1648 width and 624×2 + 39 = 1287 height
If your monitor's available height (screen.availHeight) is less than 1287 pixels (common on 1080p monitors with taskbar taking space, or smaller displays), the function returns ×1 as the max.
It will not allow you to change the screen scale.
You will also want to add this to your package.json on release build
Code:
"chromium-args": "--force-color-profile=srgb --force-device-scale-factor=1",
If you want it to also work on test play you will want a watcher.
